[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · **English** # agy-dart **Google Antigravity plugin — Save tokens · Improve KV-cache hits · Keep cache warm automatically · Protect context quota · Rescue crashed sessions** No extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in Sidecar dashboard [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [![Clones](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/repo-traffic-archive/main/badges/Antigravity-agy-dart.json)](https://github.com/zou172866/repo-traffic-archive) [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this Google Antigravity plugin do? `agy-dart` is a performance, KV-cache, and context-window plugin for **Google Antigravity** (also supports Claude Code and Codex via `--target`). It reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin stabilizes controllable client-side prefixes and reduces repeated reads of unchanged files; actual cache hit rates still depend on how the host constructs requests and on backend caching behavior (if you use a dynamic proxy pool, pinning a single exit node can serve as a controlled troubleshooting experiment). Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; all plugin responses stay within 8.8 KB, dynamically giving short passing checks' unused space to failing stack traces. 8. **Detailed panel breakdown & offline simulation**: Inspect context usage across file reads, terminal output, and subagents, check 15-turn cache hit trends and miss causes, optionally read only changed lines after edits (off by default), or replay past chat history via CLI to measure cache hit rates and keepalive cost. 9. **Complements Agent Skills & audits Skills prefix tax**: Works orthogonally alongside domain Agent Skills in Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex — Skills guide task workflows while `agy-dart` handles low-level read guards, log filtering, and KV-cache hygiene underneath; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to inspect Turn-0 frontmatter overhead and progressive-disclosure structure across installed skills. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Use **Node.js 22.16.0 or later in the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or later**. The installer checks that the built-in SQLite supports FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer. The plugin uses only built-in modules. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.5/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.5/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.7.5 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.5 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. User-created `rules/*.local.md` files inside the plugin directory are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Indexed content and usage history are stored locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` by default and survive uninstall. Before uninstalling, `ctx_purge` can clear the current chat's index. When the host omits a session ID, this covers anonymous data for the confirmed workspace. To clear indexed data and history across all projects, call `ctx_purge` with `scope: "all"`. Global uninstall also removes the Gemini/T3 copies recorded by the installer. If an older copy has no ownership record, the installer prints its location and a command for removing that copy explicitly. --- ## Settings Automatic cache keepalive is off by default. To opt in for one chat, turn on **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel. **Global Warm** sets the default count and schedule (**Auto** adaptive TTL, **Fixed 4min / 9min / 15min**, or **Custom** 1–60min; also configurable via `ttlKeepaliveIntervalSec` / `AGY_DART_TTL_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL_SEC`) for chats without a per-window override. Turning off warming for a chat silences its cache-expiry and keepalive-limit desktop alerts. Desktop alerts for stalled tasks default to off and can be enabled separately. Each keepalive requests an `OK` reply and consumes model input, including the full prompt on a cache miss. The panel also controls desktop alerts, protection, local cleanup, and file-size limits. Preset modes & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ``` > **Troubleshooting (`ide-tools` duplicate `/required` error):** If Antigravity fails during toolbox initialization with `building toolbox: tool "mcp_ide-tools_mcp_agy-dart_fast_apply_edits" advertises an invalid parameter schema ... at '/required': items at 1 and 2 are equal`, the host's `ide-tools` bridge is re-wrapping already-eager `mcp_agy-dart_fast_*` tools and appending `toolSummary` to `/required` a second time without deduplicating (`agy-dart` itself only declares `"required": ["edits"]`). Switch to lazy loading and restart Antigravity: > > ```bash > node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy > ``` > > (Or remove `"tools"` / `"eager": true` under `mcpServers.fast` in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/mcp_config.json` and restart. See [skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md](skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md) for diagnostics.) --- ## Changelog ### v1.7.5 - **Auto-Keepalive narrow-margin safety guard & unified expiry countdown**: Added `ttlKeepaliveMinRemainSec` (`AGY_DART_TTL_KEEPALIVE_MIN_REMAIN_SEC`, default `15s`, `0` disables) so adaptive auto-keepalive skips dispatching when remaining margin is too tight for delivery and falls back cleanly to desktop expiry alerts using one unified inference-origin countdown across Watchdog, alerts, and the dashboard. - **One-click manual warm (`Warm 1×`) with atomic claim & delayed cold-miss verification**: Added a manual warm button next to the TTL countdown (works even when auto-keepalive is off, without consuming auto-keepalive quota), backed by atomic SQLite claiming, 15s debounce, async rollback on dispatch failure, and Stop/delayed-flush cold-read circuit-breaker verification. ### v1.7.4 - **Friendly semantic handoff prompt greeting & opening cue**: Updated the Sidecar dashboard's **Copy Handoff Prompt** templates to open with a warm greeting (`宝宝，` in Chinese / `Sweetie, please ...` in English) and instruct the current window to start the generated handoff brief's very first sentence with the matching opening word (`宝宝，` / `Sweetie,`) while keeping strict no-filler output rules intact. ### v1.7.3 - **Selectable Auto-Keepalive intervals**: Pick **Auto** (existing adaptive mode), **Fixed 4min / 9min / 15min**, or **Custom (1–60min)** globally or per chat, with one-click **Global** reset; existing safety guards (max count, minimum context threshold, cold-miss stop, subagent skip) still apply. - **No more false warnings on check timeouts or partial test passes**: Timed-out commands no longer trigger "repeated edit-fail" alerts; passing an unrelated test or single case won't clear an earlier suite failure; background test failures stay visible after editing other files; truncated failing check batches stay flagged until re-run. - **Cleaner Handoff Brief & cache-miss diagnostics**: One-click cache-friendly handoff briefs with automatic secret redaction, plus clearer cache-miss cause breakdowns. ### v1.7.2 - **Agent Skills progressive disclosure & prefix-tax audit**: Restructured `skills/agy-dart/` with on-demand `examples/` (`ctx_trace_summary.py`, `filters.json`) and `references/error-playbook.md` synced cleanly across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex; added `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to inspect Turn-0 frontmatter tax and progressive-disclosure hygiene, and separated on-demand skill assets in `prefix:budget`. - **Scoped `dart-coder` / `dart-reviewer` check routing**: Guided built-in minimal agents to prefer `run_checks` for short checks (keeping `run_command` for `>60s` or async tasks) so command outputs stay within 8.8 KB without losing `inheritMcp: false` / `inheritCustomizations: false` isolation. - **Test & packaging hardening**: Isolated `AGY_DART_CONFIG_PATH` in `v1.2-persist-prefix.test.mjs` so local `~/.agy-dart/config.json` overrides (such as `stablePrefixOnly: true`) never interfere with unit tests, and excluded Python bytecode artifacts (`__pycache__`, `*.py[cod]`) from Git and package manifests. ### v1.7.1 - **Complete MCP receipt claiming & subagent rollup**: Extended receipt claiming to `ctx_index` and `ctx_batch` alongside `ctx_execute`, synced `sources`/`chunks` ownership (`schema v155` + `idx_sources_origin_session`), and unified `rootSessionId` rollup so subagent savings roll up into parent conversation stats without double-counting. ### v1.7.0 - **Compact signature outlines & inline read-guard outlines**: Added compact function-signature outlines and inline line-number outlines when a large un-ranged file read is intercepted on first blind read. - **Multi-host CLI (`bin/agy-dart.mjs`) & scoped subagents**: Added `agy-dart` CLI with `--target claude|codex`, `outline`, `session`, and `compare` commands, shipped `dart-coder` / `dart-reviewer` role definitions, and hardened workspace isolation & Node.js 22.16+ / 24+ SQLite FTS5 checks. ### v1.6.0 - **Optional cache keepalive** sends a ping for primary chats shortly before expiry. The panel controls the per-chat limit. Your next message resets the count. - Moved current context usage, cache countdown, and blocked noise volume into a larger top card in the panel. ### v1.5.3 - **Project & chat titles on multi-window alerts**: Desktop popups and panel alerts show folder names (e.g., `work/agy-dart`) and short chat titles without exposing message text. - **"Context Almost Full" desktop alert**: Pops up once near the limit and resets after `/compact`. ### v1.5.2 - Faster file reads and chat startup; added local panel request checks; **automatic structure, sample, and error extraction for huge JSON files**; added `gh`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, and `playwright` output trimming plus handoff summaries. ### v1.1.0 - **Automatic terminal output trimming**: Strips progress bars and repetitive noise from `git`, test, build, and install commands while saving full logs locally. - Unchanged-file duplicate-read protection, edit-fail loop notes, internal-URL SSRF blocking, log secret masking, and one-click panel cleanup. --- ## Local Checks ```bash npm test # Run full test suite npm run verify:pkg # Verify installer file list npm run prefix:budget # Estimate configured Antigravity startup and full-catalog token usage npm run brief:check # Check that AI_REVIEW_BRIEF.md line/test counts are up to date node scripts/cache-audit.mjs --workspace . --no-live node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills --workspace . # Audit Skills Turn-0 frontmatter tax & progressive disclosure npm run cache:simulate ``` After adding, removing, or editing modules or tests, keep these three places in sync so local checks stay green: - **Installer file list** (`scripts/install.mjs`): update `RUNTIME_FILES` (installed by default) or `DEVTOOLS_FILES` (`--with-devtools`) whenever files are added or removed, or `npm run verify:pkg` will fail. - **Test count check** (`tests/v1.2-hardening.test.mjs`): when the test count changes, update the hardcoded `computeBriefMetrics(ROOT).testCases` number to match `npm test`. - **Review brief** (`AI_REVIEW_BRIEF.md`): after changing tracked source files or test counts, run `node scripts/gen-review-brief.mjs --write` to refresh the numbers, then verify with `npm run brief:check`. --- ## Credits & License [MIT License](LICENSE). --- ## What does this Google Antigravity plugin do? `agy-dart` is a performance, KV-cache, and context-window plugin for **Google Antigravity** (also supports Claude Code and Codex via `--target`). It reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin stabilizes controllable client-side prefixes and reduces repeated reads of unchanged files; actual cache hit rates still depend on how the host constructs requests and on backend caching behavior (if you use a dynamic proxy pool, pinning a single exit node can serve as a controlled troubleshooting experiment). Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; To opt in for one chat, turn on **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel. **Global Warm** sets the default count and schedule (**Auto** adaptive TTL, **Fixed 4min / 9min / 15min**, or **Custom** 1–60min; also configurable via `ttlKeepaliveIntervalSec` / `AGY_DART_TTL_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL_SEC`) for chats without a per-window override. --- > **仓库边界说明**：本仓库（[`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)）包含 **AGY Market** 客户端 Sidebar 侧边栏、Windows 锁安全安装器、`npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market` 一行安装 CLI 与静态展示站（`site/`）。 > > 如需将你的插件收录至社区插件目录，点击市场顶部的 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 按钮或直接阅读 **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)**，向 **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** 提交单文件 YAML Pull Request。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性（v1.7.1） ### 0. v1.7.1 升级亮点 - **Track 2 极速流畅渲染与增量加载**：发现页采用 48 张卡片分页增量渲染（`IntersectionObserver` 触底自动追加 + 可见「加载更多」兜底按钮），配合卡片 `content-visibility: auto` 视口隔离、移除每张卡片高开销 `backdrop-filter` / `filter: blur` 合成层、根容器事件委托、150ms 搜索防抖与 `requestAnimationFrame` 光斑节流，开启近千个 Track 2 插件后依然丝滑流畅。 - **修复 Track 2 开关偶发无响应与并发回跳**：将 `#track2-checkbox` 从后台更新检查全局锁彻底解耦（仅在自身保存期间显示「切换中…」加载态并防重入），配置保存改用乐观更新与失败自动回滚，Toast 通知使用独立挂载节点更新不再触发全量卡片重建，并为 `loadState` / `updatePrefs` 及后端目录加载增加请求序号与缓存回退保护。
查看 v1.7.0 既有特性（系统代理自动适配 / 无上限流式大插件 / Monorepo 更新防误判 / Release 自动化） - **零依赖 HTTP/HTTPS 与 Windows 系统代理自动适配**：新增 `src/shared/proxy-fetch.mjs` 代理感知网络层，自动读取 `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY`（支持 `NO_PROXY` 并旁路 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost`）以及 Windows 注册表系统代理（`HKCU\...\Internet Settings`），彻底解决仅开启本地代理未开 TUN 时 GitHub 归档拉取超时问题。 - **取消 100 MB 插件大小门禁与全流式解压校验**：移除 `MAX_TARBALL_BYTES` 人为 `100 MB` 归档上限（设为无限制 `0`），改为全流式 Gunzip + POSIX/PAX Tar 落盘解包（O(MB) 内存占用）、`60s` 分块静默失活超时与 `server.requestTimeout = 0`，并新增 `GB` 体积显示，轻松支持 >100MB 乃至 GB 级含本地二进制/模型资源的插件。 - **Monorepo / 原生 Git / 无版本插件更新防误判**：更新检测对未收录、无收据的外部 Monorepo 插件（如 `upstash/context7`）核验远端 Tag 对应子目录 `plugin.json` 是否存在及版本是否真正领先；同时自动识别含 `.git` 目录的原生克隆插件（`conductor`、`sepia` 等）及无 `version` 声明插件，将其移出自动与批量更新队列并在卡片/抽屉展示只读「`Git 原生` / `无版本号`」胶囊，杜绝误报降级与软链拦截报错。 - **`app.asar` 补丁脚本引导与 `preservePaths` 合并保留**：安装或更新含 `app-asar` 宿主增强的插件后，弹窗、顶部横幅与详情抽屉明确提示先按插件文档运行其自带补丁脚本（如 `node setup.cjs`）再重启 Antigravity，并在每次市场更新后重新运行补丁脚本同步注入客户端代码，同时提供一键「复制插件目录」与「查看补丁文档」按钮；目录安装通道同步合并已有 `.agy-market-receipt.json` 与目录声明的 `preservePaths`，升级时保护用户配置不被覆盖。 - **`npx` GitHub 引导入口修复与 Release 自动化**：将尚未发布至 npm 的旧 `npx` 包名入口统一替换为直接可运行的 `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market`，修复 `scripts/install-local.mjs` 在 `_npx/.../node_modules/agy-market` 缓存路径下因全路径匹配 `node_modules` 误过滤全部文件的缺陷；新增 `.github/workflows/release.yml` 在推送 `v*` 标签时自动打包并发布 `agy-market.tar.gz` 与 `.sha256` 至 GitHub Releases。
查看 v1.6.0 既有特性（综合推荐排序 / 按需 README 缓存 / 作用域符号链接 / 零 PII 提名） - **默认「综合推荐」排序 + Monorepo 视口展位阻尼**：默认按目录质量评分（`ranking.score`，旧目录/自定义源自动回退 `stars`）排序，并对同一 `repositoryId` 的 Monorepo 子插件应用 `1 / (1 + 0.15 * (k - 1))` 阻尼，避免单一多插件仓库霸占首页前排；保留按星标、最近更新、名称排序。 - **按需单插件 README 懒加载与本地 ETag 缓存**：详情抽屉与 `GET /api/readme` / `GET /api/plugin/:id/readme` 优先按需拉取 `dist/readmes/.json`（独立 ETag 缓存于 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/cache/readmes/.json`），无缝回退至传统 `readmes.json`、中国大陆 npm 镜像或已安装本地 README。 - **子目录作用域符号链接兼容（不降级安全红线）**：对位于所选 `pluginRoot` 之外的仓库符号链接（如双宿主 `.claude/` 或 `docs/` 软链）自动跳过不再误报阻断；`pluginRoot` 内部、祖先目录、目标穿越进入 `pluginRoot` 或根目录插件（`pluginRoot === '.'`）的任何符号链接仍一律硬拦截 `ERR_TAR_SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN`。 - **零 PII 公开插件一键社区提名**：通过「链接添加」安装未收录的公开 GitHub 仓库时，经无鉴权 `HEAD` 确认公开后展示非阻塞的「分享此公开插件到 AGY Market？」引导（私有/404 仓库永不提示），预填 GitHub Issue 仅包含 `owner/repo` 与 `plugin_root`。
### 1. Sidebar 侧边栏界面、15 大精准分类与导航体验 - **原生右侧 Sidebar 侧边栏**：基于 Antigravity 原生 `AUX_PANE` 扩展视图（`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`），不捆绑常驻 MCP 服务，打开即用、轻量流畅。 - **15 大精准分类体系（含 `all` 共 16 项）**：新增 **状态与用量监控（`monitoring-quota`）**、**上下文与缓存加速（`context-cache`）**、**多代理与思考控制（`agents-reasoning`）** 等高辨识度细分品类；探索页自动按目录数据动态生成分类胶囊、支持按中英文分类名实时搜索并在卡片与详情抽屉展示分类微标签。 - **顶部概览栏与插件卡片**：顶部可折叠概览栏实时展示「已收录插件 / 运行中 / 可更新 / 本地冲突」，顶栏内置 **`链接添加`**（粘贴任意 GitHub 链接预检安装）与 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 快捷入口；卡片样式适配暗色、亮色与半透明壁纸皮肤（如 Wallpaper Prism）。 - **双行标题 + 一键直达 GitHub**：点击探索卡片、收藏卡片、已安装卡片或详情抽屉的**插件标题**可直接在新窗口打开对应 GitHub 仓库，点击卡片其余区域展开详情抽屉。 - **开箱优先呈现简体中文文档**：详情抽屉请求 `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh`，自动优先渲染目录源 `entriesZh` 或本地 `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md`，并在已安装卡片优先显示中文化简介。 - **点击「面板」一键直开目标 Sidebar 侧边栏**：移除会被 Chromium 拦截的裸 `` 链接；在宿主侧边栏内点击其他 Sidebar 插件卡片上的「面板」按钮时，直接调用宿主 `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane`（`tabType: "sidecarView"`）拉起或聚焦对应侧边栏，无需手动复制提示。 ### 2. 锁安全一键卸载、Sidebar 全通道直装更新与按需「一键更新」 - **彻底杜绝同版本无效更新（v1.5.4）**：前后端共享 SemVer 严格对账与服务端最新目录源优先机制，消除跨快照状态失步导致的 `vX.Y.Z → vX.Y.Z` 误报与陈旧数据降级重装；常规更新命中已最新或同 Tag/Commit 时免下载短路返回 `ALREADY_UP_TO_DATE`，详情抽屉保留显式「重新同步（`forceResync`）」能力。 - **锁安全插件卸载（Sidebar 卡片/详情抽屉 + `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall `）**： - 每张可卸载全局已安装插件卡片与详情抽屉均内置 **「卸载」** 按钮（`POST /api/uninstall`，同时兼容 `/api/remove-files`），确认弹窗支持可选勾选「同时从收藏夹移除」。 - 统一覆盖活跃目录（`~/.gemini/config/plugins/`）与停放仓（`${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`）；绝不写 `config.json` 或调用受限 RPC；遇到符号链接/NTFS Junction 仅删除链接本身绝不误删源目录；Windows 下遇到 `EBUSY` 文件锁自动 `.old.` 改名退避并立即摘除 `plugin.json`，下次启动由 `sweepRetiredBinaries` 自动清扫残留空壳目录；硬性拦截 `agy-market` 自删（`ERR_CANNOT_SELF_DELETE`）及 `workspace` / `builtin` 插件误删。 - **Sidebar 内全通道直装更新（告别外链手动下载）**： - 当检测到 GitHub 上游 Release/Tag 领先于目录版本或来源于 GitHub URL 时，`GET /api/updates` 统一标记 `installable: true`（`updateChannel: 'catalog' | 'github-upstream' | 'github-url'`），点击更新直接在 Sidebar 内完成拉取、预检与原位升级，彻底移除跳转外部浏览器的上游外链按钮。 - 目录认证插件通过 GitHub 上游通道直装更新时，100% 保留原有 `receipt.track`（如 `'verified'`）与 `repositoryId`，并持续执行能力增量确认门禁。 - **每张已安装卡片配智能「更新 / 最新」状态切换 + 顶栏按需「一键更新」**： - 所有具备远端更新源的已安装插件卡片在发现新版本时展示直装 **「更新 vX.Y.Z」** 按钮，更新完成或检查确认为最新版后自动切换为不可点击的 **「✓ 最新」** 提示胶囊（未检查时点击「更新」先核验，若已是最新不重复下载重装）；纯本地无源插件展示不可点击的「本地 / 工作区 / 内置」状态胶囊（接口返回 `ERR_NO_UPDATE_SOURCE`）；对未通过市场安装且包含 `.git` 目录的原生克隆插件或未声明 `version` 的外部插件展示只读 **「Git 原生 / 无版本号」** 状态胶囊并自动排除在自动更新与批量更新之外。 - 「已安装」页签顶栏在 **「检查更新」** 旁按需显示 **「一键更新 (N)」** 按钮：当检测到可安装更新（或批量更新进行中）时显示，按序批量更新 `catalog`、`github-upstream` 与 `github-url` 全部通道（并将 `agy-market` 自身更新严格排在最后触发重启）；全部插件处于最新版本时自动隐藏，保持界面清爽。 ### 3. ⭐ 插件收藏栏、已安装搜索筛选与更新失败告警 - **⭐ 插件收藏栏 & 独立「收藏」标签页**： - 每张插件卡片（探索、收藏、已安装）与详情抽屉顶部均内置 `☆` / 琥珀金 `★` 收藏按钮，点击调用 `POST /api/favorites` 原子持久化至本地 `prefs.json`（无需重复配置）。 - 收藏任意插件后，「探索」页顶部自动浮现可折叠的 **「★ 我的收藏栏」** 快捷入口；顶部导航同步提供独立 **「★ 收藏」** 标签页（`探索 · 收藏 · 已安装 · 冲突与诊断 · 源与设置`），支持全文检索与快速启停/安装。 - **语言无关与 SHA-256 校验下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会比对目录源中的 `sha256` 摘要，不匹配时立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用，直连 GitHub 零 npm 发布依赖） ```bash npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 通过 GitHub 完整链接添加插件 无需等待目录收录，v1.4.0 起可直接通过 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装任意社区插件，自动兼容单插件子目录、Monorepo 多插件目录及无 Release Tag 的默认分支提交。 ### 方式一：UI 顶栏「链接添加」按钮（两步式预检安装） 1. 打开 AGY Market 侧边栏，点击顶栏右上角 **`链接添加`** 按钮（或在探索页搜索无结果时点击 **「通过 GitHub 链接添加」**）。 2. 粘贴任意 GitHub 完整链接并点击 **「解析预检」**，支持以下链接形式： - 仓库主页：`https://github.com//`（自动按最新 Release → Git Tag → 默认分支提交解析） - 分支或子目录：`https://github.com///tree//` - 清单文件直链：`https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - 指定 Release / 标签 / 归档直链：`/releases/tag/`、`/releases/latest`、`/releases/download//.tar.gz`、`/archive/...tar.gz` 3. 后端在插件外置暂存目录下载归档并完成本地静态检查： - **自动识别布局**：兼容根目录 `plugin.json`、`.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`、唯一命名子目录自动定位（如 `agy-capsule/plugin.json`）；若仓库为 Monorepo 多插件布局（如 `plugins/*`、`.agents/plugins/*`），弹窗将列出全部候选子目录供直接点选。 - **预检与安全拦截**：安装前明确展示版本号或短 `commitSha`、SHA-256 摘要、能力徽章及安装方式（原生目录名或 `--` 隔离目录名）；若仓库不含有效 `plugin.json` 或命中路径穿越、软硬链接、规则越界注入等安全规则，将提示原因并清理暂存目录，不产生残留。 - **已安装联动更新**：通过链接安装的插件在「已安装」页带有 `GitHub URL` 来源标签，支持滑块启停、详情抽屉查看，并可按 Release Tag 或分支最新 Commit SHA 一键检查更新。 ### 方式二：CLI `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add ` ```bash # 预检并交互确认安装任意 GitHub 插件仓库（兼容子目录与无 Tag 默认分支） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com// # 指定 Monorepo 子目录，使用 -- 隔离目录名并跳过交互确认 npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # 可选参数：--replace（替换同源目录）、--dest 、--mirror 、--token 、--json npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ 能力徽章与升级权限增量确认 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的能力徽章： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式技能` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无后台常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar 侧边栏` | 在右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏提供可视化交互界面 | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 已验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market install # 通过任意 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装插件（支持 --subpath / --isolate / --replace / --yes / --dest / --mirror / --token / --json） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add # 锁安全卸载已安装的全局社区插件（别名 remove；支持 --yes / --dest / --json） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall --yes --json # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market status npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market status --json # 运行安装检查（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidebar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行安装检查 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - Local Plugin Conflict Checks & Fixes Dedicated **Conflicts & Diagnostics** tab (`GET /api/conflicts`) with read-only static conflict checks and one-click fixes (`POST /api/fix-conflict`): | Check | Severity | What It Detects | Quick Action | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | Critical | Duplicate `plugin.json.name` across `workspace > global > builtin` precedence, pinpointing the winner and silently dropped victim directories | 1-click `--` scoped isolation rename | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | Critical | Symlinks or NTFS junctions inside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` that Windows `GetAllPlugins` silently skips | 1-click materialize to real directory | | `mcp-collision` | Critical / Warning | Duplicate `_` keys, collisions with global `mcp_config.json`, or bare generic server names (`search`, `db`, `fetch`, etc.) | Pinpoints colliding keys & sources | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | Warning | Overlapping `skills/*/SKILL.md` or `agents/*.md` across active plugins, `~/.gemini/config/skills/*`, and built-in reserved names | Shows full override chain | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | Warning / Info | Two or more active plugins modifying `app.asar` (**Warning**, patch overlap risk) or using `cdp` UI enhancements (**Info**, generally compatible) | Advisory to review or disable duplicate | ### 6. Action-Triggered Restart & Reload Prompts Cards and the Detail Drawer stay clutter-free without static restart chips. Activation prompts appear **only after an install, update, batch update, or uninstall completes** (or when a Windows disable/uninstall retires a locked binary): - **Declarative Skills / Global Rules (`instant`)**: Hot-reloads immediately with no restart required. - **Sidebar Panel / MCP / Hooks (`reload-pane`)**: Prompts to reopen the Sidebar panel or refresh MCP after update/install completes. - **`app.asar` / First-Time `cdp` / Retired Locked Binaries (`host-restart`)**: Displays a clear banner reminding you to restart Antigravity for changes to take full effect. For `app.asar` patch plugins, both the banner and Detail Drawer clearly instruct you to run the plugin's bundled patch script (e.g., `node setup.cjs` per plugin docs) before restarting and re-run it after every AGY Market update, with one-click **Copy Plugin Folder** and **Patch Docs** helpers. ### 7. Built-In GitHub Discussions Integration - Every plugin Detail Drawer includes a **Discussions** tab (`GET /api/discussions`) that detects whether Discussions are enabled on the repository without needing a token and provides direct links to browse or start a thread. - Optionally configuring a personal GitHub Token in Settings (stored locally in `prefs.json` with `0600` permissions; never logged or persisted in caches) loads the latest 10 repository discussions directly inside the Sidebar panel. ### 8. Dual-Mirror China Acceleration & SHA-256 Verified Installs - **Three-Tier Live Catalog Resolution (No Stale Bundled Snapshot)**: 1. **Custom Feeds**: User/team static `index.json` URLs configured in `prefs.json` take highest priority. 2. **Primary Channel (GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw Fallback)**: Conditional `ETag` (`If-None-Match`) / `If-Modified-Since` requests achieve `<50ms` `304 Not Modified` cache hits. 3. **Automatic Mainland China Mirror Fallback**: If GitHub Pages times out (`> 3.5s`) or fails, streams the pure-JSON `@agy-market/catalog` transport package from `registry.npmmirror.com` or `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm` in memory; falls back to disk cache when offline. - **Language-Agnostic & SHA-256 Verified**: npm is used **strictly** as a JSON mirror CDN for catalog metadata—listed plugins do **not** need to be npm or JavaScript projects. Optional GitHub Release mirror prefixes are supported safely because every tarball is streamed and verified against the catalog `sha256` digest before extraction (`INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` aborts immediately on any mismatch). --- ## 🚀 One-Line Bootstrap Install > Requires **Node.js >= 22.0.0** (zero runtime npm dependencies), or use the zero-npm OS installers below. - **Node / `npx` (Cross-Platform, Recommended — runs directly from GitHub)**: ```bash npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market ``` - **Windows PowerShell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` - **macOS / Linux Shell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Once installed in Antigravity: - Open the Sidebar Panel: click `[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` in chat, or open **Sidebar (`+`) → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`**. - Manage on Native Customizations Page: `[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 Adding Plugins from Any GitHub URL Starting with v1.4.0, you can preflight and install any community plugin directly from a full GitHub URL without waiting for catalog indexing — including single-subdirectory layouts, Monorepos, and repositories without Release tags. ### Option 1: Sidebar Top Bar `Add URL` (`链接添加`) Button (Two-Step Preflight) 1. # Wallpaper Prism (`agy-wallpaper-prism`)

> **Repository**: [https://github.com/azwosile/agy-wallpaper-prism](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-wallpaper-prism)  
> **Version**: `2.3.0` · **Zero Agent Tokens** · **Zero `app.asar` Modification** · **License**: MIT

**适用于 Google Antigravity 的棱镜液态玻璃皮肤与动态壁纸工作台**  
**Obsidian Prism Liquid Glass Skin & Wallpaper Engine Studio for Google Antigravity**

**语言 / Language**: [**简体中文**](#简体中文文档) · [**English**](#english-documentation) · [**更新日志 / Changelog**](docs/CHANGELOG.md) · [**文档索引 / Docs Index**](docs/README.md)

---

## 简体中文文档

### 1. 简介与 `v2.3.0` 核心亮点

`agy-wallpaper-prism` 为 Google Antigravity 2.x 带来基于 **Obsidian Prism** 光学层次体系的整窗液态玻璃皮肤，以及兼容 **Steam Wallpaper Engine (`431960`)** 与本地多媒体的动态壁纸工作台：

- **零 Agent 上下文 / Token 消耗**：插件默认不向模型注入任何 MCP 工具或系统提示词，渲染、流媒体与皮肤控制完全在带外 Sidecar 进程中运行。
- **零 `app.asar` 侵入修改**：通过 **Zero-Enable Ephemeral CDP**（零持久域：严格禁用 `Page.enable`、`Runtime.enable`、`Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument` 与 `Runtime.addBinding`）进行安全挂载，并具备 **Fail-Open** 首帧就绪门控与双阶段 `fsync` 启动金丝雀熔断保护。

#### `v2.3.0` 新特性亮点

1. **CDP 真实宿主窗口点击拾取区域检查器（`#14 阶段二`）**
   - 在 **可视化外观编辑器** 或独立 **浏览器全屏编辑器（Popout IDE）** 中点击 **「🎯 拾取真实界面区域」**，即可直接在真实的 Antigravity 主窗口上悬停高亮并点选任意 8 个界面区域（`topbar`、`wco`、`sidebar`、`workspace`、`card`、`composer`、`rightPane`、`popover`）。
   - **零微引导体积增量**：Sidecar 通过 `POST /api/inspector/pick` 与 `evaluateTargetEphemeral` 按需挂载 `GET /host/<capToken>/inspector.js`（`src/host/inspector-inject.js`），**对 `buildHostMicroBootstrap`（上限 `<= 6,144 B`）保持 `0 B` 增量**。
   - **全模式通用**：纯结构化几何命中检测（零本地化文本匹配，100% 兼容中文汉化包），同时支持 **`gentle-auto` 实时模式**、**`static-css` 纯静态模式** 与 **`manual` / 停用皮肤状态**；支持 `Esc`、右键或 **「✕ 取消拾取」**（`POST /api/inspector/cancel`）随时退出，并内置 45 秒安全超时与 Aux Pane / Popout 双通道 SSE 实时同步。
2. **双形态可视化区域编辑器 & 统一 8 区域光学架构（`v2.2.0`–`v2.3.0`）**
   - **双形态工作流**：支持在 Sidecar 右侧工作台内全高弹出（`50%–200%` 缩放平移画布）以及在独立浏览器窗口打开全屏 3 栏 IDE（`/?mode=visual-editor`，由 `POST /api/studio/popout` 严格鉴权拉起，`CSP: frame-ancestors 'none'`，URL 零 `?token=`）。
   - **8 区域 × 11 项精调属性**：`topbar`、`wco`、`sidebar`、`workspace`、`card`、`composer`、`rightPane`、`popover` 各自独立调节毛玻璃开关、模糊半径（`0..64px`）、不透明度、色彩深浅、自定义底色、边框不透明度（支持随表面透明自动渐隐至 `0%`）、边框形态、圆角、字号、字体家族（内置 8 套 CJK 安全字体预设）与文字颜色（带反锚点 WCAG AA `>= 4.5:1` 智能护栏及一键原始色值解锁）。
   - **Topbar / WCO 融合（`D18`）**：支持 Antigravity `2.35.1` 紧凑顶栏形态（`pills` / `bar`）及独立调节右上角透明窗口控制胶囊 `#agy-prism-wco-pill`（`z-index: 0`）。
3. **无内存体积限制的直连视频播放与自动降级（`bb06577`）**
   - 移除宿主跨协议 `fetch+blob` 播放体积限制（`MAX_BLOB_MEDIA_BYTES = Infinity`，`BLOB_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 60000`），完整保留视频原生音频；在非 `404` 失败或超时时自动无缝回退至 `MediaSource` `/mse-fmp4/` 零转码分片流或静态封面，同时严格保持 `404`/`403`/`410` 的 Fail-Open 容错。
4. **单实例 Sidecar 所有权围栏与孤儿自退出（PR `#11` + `v2.2.0` 接管加固）**
   - 合并来自 `@zmzwynzj` 的 **PR `#11`**（`88a6a0a`：`instanceId` 原子围栏、`cdp-bridge.mjs` 让权终止 `600ms` SSE 重连抢占死循环、受管父进程孤儿退避自退出），与 `v2.2.0` 身份校验 `/api/shutdown` 接管、`install-local.mjs` 开关状态保活及 `DEV_WATCH_ENABLED` 生产零轮询门禁协同工作，杜绝双进程抢占闪烁与孤儿进程残留。
5. **快捷浮窗（`Ctrl+Alt+W`）、4 套纯 CSS 侧栏与 Layer B 低功耗休眠**
   - 支持 **三端一键主开关**（工作台顶栏、`Ctrl+Alt+W` 快捷浮窗顶栏、输入框页脚 `#agy-prism-pill` 的 `Shift+Click` / 中键直切），非破坏性软停用可在 `<50ms` 内瞬间恢复。
   - **4 套纯 CSS 侧栏列表风格**（`capsule`、`underline`、`accordion`、`tree`，零 DOM 注入）+ `11..15px` 均衡字号 + 与 `Antigravity-Chinese-Localization` 四层隔离共存。
   - 静默自动保存（`keepalive` 退避落盘）、独立命名配置快照、21:9 静态优先预览、悬停动效缩略图，以及隐藏态 `COLD_DORMANT` -> `SOFT_SLEEP` -> `DEEP_SLEEP` 冷启动休眠。

---

### 2. 安装方式

#### 方式 A：通过 GitHub Releases 压缩包安装（推荐普通用户）

1. 前往 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-wallpaper-prism/releases) 下载对应版本的 `agy-wallpaper-prism-v2.3.0.tar.gz`（或 `.zip`）以及 `agy-wallpaper-prism-v2.3.0.tar.gz.sha256` 校验文件。
2. 校验压缩包 SHA-256 完整性后，将其**完整解压为真实文件夹**（Windows 下**切勿**使用 NTFS 目录联接 Junction 或符号链接 Symlink，Antigravity 会跳过非真实目录）至：
   - `<USER_HOME>/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-wallpaper-prism`
3. 在 Antigravity 内打开 [Wallpaper Prism 扩展管理页](customization://agy-wallpaper-prism) 确认已启用，之后即可在工作台顶部或 **宿主与系统** 标签页使用 **GitHub Release 一键自更新**（自动校验 `.sha256` 与 `tar-safe.mjs` 安全解包并在失败时原子回滚）。

#### 方式 B：通过 Antigravity Customizations / Market 安装

- 在 Antigravity 打开 **Customizations / 扩展市场**（或点击 [Wallpaper Prism](customization://agy-wallpaper-prism)），搜索 `Wallpaper Prism`（`agy-wallpaper-prism`）并启用。

#### 方式 C：本地源码开发安装（需 Node.js `>= 22.0.0`）

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/azwosile/agy-wallpaper-prism.git
cd agy-wallpaper-prism

# 1. 编译单文件纯 LF 确定性 Studio 前端产物（零外部 npm 依赖）
node scripts/build.mjs

# 2. 以真实文件拷贝安装到 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-wallpaper-prism 并热同步在途实例
node scripts/install-local.mjs
```

> **开发模式提示**：从 Git 仓库本地安装的版本内置了防覆盖守卫，一键更新按钮会返回 `409 ERR_GIT_DEV_CHECKOUT`；请使用 `git pull && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/install-local.mjs` 更新。

---

### 3. 快速开始与使用指南

### 6. 常见问题与排障

- **工作台显示「待机中 (未开启 CDP)」或实时区域拾取提示未检测到宿主窗口**
  - 请先确认 Antigravity 是否带 `--remote-debugging-port` 启动：点击工作台 **宿主与系统** -> **一键开启普通快捷方式自动加载**（或执行 `npm run enable-autostart`），重启 Antigravity 即可生效。为防止与用户外部调试端口冲突，冷启动默认不主动探测公共 `9222` 端口。
- **大型视频壁纸未自动播放或显示为静态封面**
  - `v2.3.0` 已解除 `fetch+blob` 体积限制（`MAX_BLOB_MEDIA_BYTES = Infinity`，超时 `60s`）；若宿主网络环境或编码触发回退，引擎会自动尝试 `MediaSource` `/mse-fmp4/` 零转码分片流（需系统 `PATH` 中存在 `ffmpeg`）。若环境未安装 `ffmpeg`，视频将自动平滑降级为静态封面且不影响玻璃皮肤渲染。
- **多窗口 / 异常状态 / Windows 安装未生效**
  - Windows 下切勿使用 NTFS Junction/Symlink，请始终使用 `node scripts/install-local.mjs` 或解压真实目录。若曾存在旧版 Sidecar 残留，PR `#11` 的 `instanceId` 围栏与孤儿自退出会自动清理；可通过 `npm run status` 检查存活实例端口与状态。
- **如何快速还原 Antigravity 原生外观**
  - 任意时刻按 **`Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R`** 或连续按 **`4× Esc`**，或在工作台顶部开关 / `Ctrl+Alt+W` 浮窗一键关闭，也可运行 `npm run restore` 或 `npm run reset-canary`。
- **与 `Antigravity-Chinese-Localization` 汉化插件共存**
  - 皮肤与 `v2.3.0` 实时区域拾取器均只使用结构化选择器，状态属性仅挂载于 `<html>`（零 `<body>` DOM 变异），不会干扰汉化翻译生命周期。

### 6. Troubleshooting

- **Standby (`cdpReachable: false`) or Live Picker reports no reachable host window**
  - Ensure Antigravity was launched with `--remote-debugging-port` by clicking **Enable Normal Shortcut Auto-Load** in **Host & System** (or running `npm run enable-autostart`), then restart Antigravity once. Prism intentionally avoids probing shared port `9222` on cold boot unless configured.
- **Video wallpaper does not play or falls back to static poster**
  - `v2.3.0` sets `MAX_BLOB_MEDIA_BYTES = Infinity` (`60s` timeout) for direct `fetch+blob` playback; if a stream stalls or errors (non-404), Prism falls back automatically to `MediaSource` `/mse-fmp4/` (requires `ffmpeg` on `PATH`) or a static poster while keeping glass chrome alive (`404`/`403`/`410` stay Fail-Open).
- **Multi-window / stale Sidecar / plugin not loading on Windows**
  - Never symlink or NTFS-junction the plugin directory on Windows; use `node scripts/install-local.mjs` or extract a real folder. PR `#11` fences superseded Sidecar instances and auto-exits orphans; run `npm run status` to inspect live PID/port health.
- **Instant native appearance recovery / Boot Canary tripped**
  - Press **`Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R`** or **`4× Esc`** anytime, toggle off from Studio / Quick Prism, or run `npm run restore` / `npm run reset-canary`.
- **Coexistence with `Antigravity-Chinese-Localization`**
  - Both the skin and `v2.3.0` Live Region Picker rely strictly on structural DOM selectors and `<html>`-only state attributes (`0` `<body>` mutations), preventing translation interference.

  - 请先确认 Antigravity 是否带 `--remote-debugging-port` 启动：点击工作台 **宿主与系统** -> **一键开启普通快捷方式自动加载**（或执行 `npm run enable-autostart`），重启 Antigravity 即可生效。为防止与用户外部调试端口冲突，冷启动默认不主动探测公共 `9222` 端口。
- **大型视频壁纸未自动播放或显示为静态封面**
  - `v2.3.0` 已解除 `fetch+blob` 体积限制（`MAX_BLOB_MEDIA_BYTES = Infinity`，超时 `60s`）；若宿主网络环境或编码触发回退，引擎会自动尝试 `MediaSource` `/mse-fmp4/` 零转码分片流（需系统 `PATH` 中存在 `ffmpeg`）。若环境未安装 `ffmpeg`，视频将自动平滑降级为静态封面且不影响玻璃皮肤渲染。
- **多窗口 / 异常状态 / Windows 安装未生效**
  - Windows 下切勿使用 NTFS Junction/Symlink，请始终使用 `node scripts/install-local.mjs` 或解压真实目录。若曾存在旧版 Sidecar 残留，PR `#11` 的 `instanceId` 围栏与孤儿自退出会自动清理；可通过 `npm run status` 检查存活实例端口与状态。
- **如何快速还原 Antigravity 原生外观**
  - 任意时刻按 **`Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R`** 或连续按 **`4× Esc`**，或在工作台顶部开关 / `Ctrl+Alt+W` 浮窗一键关闭，也可运行 `npm run restore` 或 `npm run reset-canary`。
- **与 `Antigravity-Chinese-Localization` 汉化插件共存**
  - 皮肤与 `v2.3.0` 实时区域拾取器均只使用结构化选择器，状态属性仅挂载于 `<html>`（零 `<body>` DOM 变异），不会干扰汉化翻译生命周期。

### 1. Overview & `v2.3.0` Release Highlights

`agy-wallpaper-prism` delivers an **Obsidian Prism** layered acrylic workbench skin and a full **Steam Wallpaper Engine (`431960`)** + local media studio for Google Antigravity 2.x:

- **Zero Agent Context/Token Overhead**: Registers no model-visible tools or prompt injections; all rendering, media streaming, and configuration run out-of-band in a gentle Sidecar process.
- **Zero `app.asar` Modification**: Attaches passively via **Zero-Enable Ephemeral CDP** (zero `Page.enable`, `Runtime.enable`, `Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument`, or `Runtime.addBinding`), gated by a Fail-Open first-frame media stage and two-phase `fsync` Boot Canary circuit breaker.

#### What's New in `v2.3.0`

1. **CDP Live Host Window Click-to-Pick Region Inspector (`#14 Phase 2`)**
   - Click **`🎯 Pick Live Host Region`** inside the Visual Appearance Editor or fullscreen Popout IDE to hover-highlight and click any of the 8 canonical UI regions (`topbar`, `wco`, `sidebar`, `workspace`, `card`, `composer`, `rightPane`, `popover`) directly inside the live Antigravity window.
   - **Zero Micro-Bootstrap Overhead**: Invoked on demand via `POST /api/inspector/pick` and `evaluateTargetEphemeral`, loading `GET /host/<capToken>/inspector.js` (`src/host/inspector-inject.js`) with **`0 B` delta** to `buildHostMicroBootstrap` (`<= 6,144 B` cap).
   - **Works Across All Startup Modes**: Uses pure structural Antigravity `2.35.1` selectors (zero localized text matching, 100% compatible with `Antigravity-Chinese-Localization`) across **`gentle-auto`**, **`static-css`**, and **`manual` / `skinEnabled: false`** states; exits cleanly via `Esc`, right-click, **`✕ Cancel Pick`** (`POST /api/inspector/cancel`), or a 45s safety timeout, broadcasting live updates across both Aux Pane and Popout SSE channels.
2. **Dual-Form Visual Region Editor & Unified 8-Region Architecture (`v2.2.0`–`v2.3.0`)**
   - **Dual Forms**: Full-height in-sidebar pan/zoom (`50%–200%`) canvas modal + standalone browser Popout IDE (`/?mode=visual-editor` launched via strict `POST /api/studio/popout` with `CSP: frame-ancestors 'none'` and zero `?token=` in URL).
   - **8 Regions × 11 Properties**: Independent control over `topbar`, `wco`, `sidebar`, `workspace`, `card`, `composer`, `rightPane`, and `popover` (blur `0..64px`, opacity, shade tone, custom tint, opacity-linked border fade to `0%`, border style, radius, font size, 8 CJK-safe font presets, and text color protected by opposite-anchor WCAG AA `>= 4.5:1` guardrails with 1-click raw unlock).

3. **Uncapped Direct Blob Media Playback + Automatic MSE/Poster Fallback (`bb06577`)**
   - Removes the memory ceiling on cross-scheme loopback `fetch+blob` playback (`MAX_BLOB_MEDIA_BYTES = Infinity`, `BLOB_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 60000`) while preserving native audio, falling back automatically to `MediaSource` `/mse-fmp4/` or static poster on non-404 errors/timeouts while keeping `404`/`403`/`410` Fail-Open.
4. **Single-Instance Sidecar Fencing & Orphan Exit (PR `#11` + `v2.2.0` Takeover)**
   - Merges **PR `#11`** by `@zmzwynzj` (`88a6a0a`: atomic `instanceId` ownership fencing in `server_info.json`, `yieldOwnership` breaking `600ms` SSE reconnect hijack loops, and managed parent-PID orphan auto-exit) alongside `v2.2.0` `/api/shutdown` takeover, `install-local.mjs` ON/OFF state preservation, and `DEV_WATCH_ENABLED` production polling suppression.
5. **Quick Prism (`Ctrl+Alt+W`), 4 Pure-CSS Sidebar Styles & Layer B Dormancy**
   - **3-Point 1-Click Master Toggle** (Studio topbar, Quick Prism topbar, `Shift+Click`/middle-click `#agy-prism-pill`) with `<50ms` non-destructive soft-disable/re-enable.
   - **4 Pure-CSS Sidebar List Styles** (`capsule`, `underline`, `accordion`, `tree` — zero DOM mutations), balanced `11..15px` typography, silent `keepalive` autosave, independent named snapshots, static-first 21:9 workbench preview, hover library thumbnails, and Layer B cold-start dormancy (`COLD_DORMANT` -> `SOFT_SLEEP` -> `DEEP_SLEEP`).

```text
agy-wallpaper-prism/
├── plugin.json                     # Official 10-key plugin manifest (version: 2.3.0)
├── package.json                    # Node >=22 ESM package & build/pack/CLI scripts
├── assets/logo.svg                 # 256×256 faceted Prism vector icon
├── docs/                           # Bilingual docs index, CHANGELOG, DSH parity spec & archives
├── skills/wallpaper-prism/SKILL.md # Agent navigation & safe CLI skill (v2.3.0)

├── src/

│   ├── engine/                     # Steam/WE scanner, MP4 faststart VFS, PKGV/LZ4, 206+/mse-fmp4/, tar-safe updater
│   ├── host/                       # Skin microkernel, Quick Prism popover & v2.3.0 live picker (inspector-inject.js)
│   └── studio-ui/                  # Acyclic L0–L6 modular Studio UI & Dual-Form Visual Region Editor
├── sidecars/prism_studio/          # Fenced single-instance Sidecar HTTP server, media proxy, Popout IDE & CDP bridge

└── test/verify-all.mjs             # 3-suite Manifest, Engine/Updater & Headless Chrome E2E verification harness
```

- **8-Region Canonical Schema**: `REGION_IDS` (`topbar`, `wco`, `sidebar`, `workspace`, `card`, `composer`, `rightPane`, `popover`) in `src/shared/schema.mjs`, each carrying 11 optical/structural properties (plus 4 sidebar typography/list-style properties) with lossless `v2.1.0` `surfaceTints` migration.

- **CDP Security & Auth Boundaries**:
  - Strictly enforces Zero-Enable Ephemeral CDP; `buildHostMicroBootstrap` stays `<= 6,144 B` (`0 B` added by the on-demand Live Region Picker).
  - Enforces global loopback `Host` DNS-rebinding guards, header-only `X-Sidecar-Token` (`0o600` `server_info.json`), and strict CSRF Origin checks on mutating routes (`/api/config`, `/api/studio/popout`, `/api/inspector/pick`, `/api/inspector/cancel`, `/api/update/*`).
  - Persists user state under `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR` (default `<USER_HOME>/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/agy-wallpaper-prism/prism_studio/data`) with automatic non-destructive migration from legacy `~/.agy-wallpaper-prism`.

### 6. Troubleshooting

- **Standby (`cdpReachable: false`) or Live Picker reports no reachable host window**
  - Ensure Antigravity was launched with `--remote-debugging-port` by clicking **Enable Normal Shortcut Auto-Load** in **Host & System** (or running `npm run enable-autostart`), then restart Antigravity once. Prism intentionally avoids probing shared port `9222` on cold boot unless configured.
- **Video wallpaper does not play or falls back to static poster**
  - `v2.3.0` sets `MAX_BLOB_MEDIA_BYTES = Infinity` (`60s` timeout) for direct `fetch+blob` playback; if a stream stalls or errors (non-404), Prism falls back automatically to `MediaSource` `/mse-fmp4/` (requires `ffmpeg` on `PATH`) or a static poster while keeping glass chrome alive (`404`/`403`/`410` stay Fail-Open).
- **Multi-window / stale Sidecar / plugin not loading on Windows**
  - Never symlink or NTFS-junction the plugin directory on Windows; use `node scripts/install-local.mjs` or extract a real folder. PR `#11` fences superseded Sidecar instances and auto-exits orphans; run `npm run status` to inspect live PID/port health.
- **Instant native appearance recovery / Boot Canary tripped**
  - Press **`Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R`** or **`4× Esc`** anytime, toggle off from Studio / Quick Prism, or run `npm run restore` / `npm run reset-canary`.
- **Coexistence with `Antigravity-Chinese-Localization`**
  - Both the skin and `v2.3.0` Live Region Picker rely strictly on structural DOM selectors and `<html>`-only state attributes (`0` `<body>` mutations), preventing translation interference.

**无打扰静默待机**：紧贴窗口右下角（`0px` 贴边），平时仅展示统一无鲸鱼耳猫娘头发与蓝紫发色、透明抠图处理的 Gemini 娘主形象，不常驻额外按钮或遮挡工作区。 - **内置两套默认皮肤一键切换**：统一以干净猫娘立绘为基底制作五帧面部表情差分，可在「挂件设置」中随时切换 **`💜 经典紫瞳`** 与 **`💗💛 粉金异瞳`**。 - **五帧表情差分自动联动**： - **平时待机 (`idle`)**：主形象立绘，伴随柔和呼吸微动； - **AI 思考 / 生成中 (`eat`)**：自动识别会话运行态或发送按钮取消态，切换「吃大米」差分； - **审查 / 确认 / 提问提示 (`wait`)**：实时结合 Language Server `waitingSteps`（支持跨项目工作区后台会话）与前端确认控件（`inline-permission-card`、`inline-card`、`ask-question`、`subagent-approve`、`Proceed` 审查卡等），自动切换专属鼓嘴 `><` 确认提醒差分并轻跳提示； - **戳一下 (`xd`)**：触发 `><` 差分、Q 弹按压回弹与离线合成音效（含爱心/星星粒子反馈）； - **对话完成 / 三连戳彩蛋 (`grin`)**：本轮输出完成或连续戳 3 下时触发「呲牙笑」差分与彩蛋音效。 - **审查与确认实时提醒气泡（不可点击穿透 + 4 秒自动收起）**： - 当任意项目触发命令/权限审批、方案审查确认、接管确认或问题询问时，立即播放专属铃音 `review_alert.wav` 并弹出琥珀高亮边框气泡，明确显示 **`【项目名】请求主人确认啦！`** 与具体待确认类型（`权限/命令待确认`、`审查需求待确认`、`提问等待主人回答` 等）； - 为避免遮挡「提交 / 确认」按钮，提醒气泡**完全不可点击穿透**并在 **4 秒后自动收起**，猫娘保持 `wait` 差分直到主人点击「Allow / Proceed / Submit / 确认」后无缝切回对应的思考（`eat`）或待机（`idle`）状态（不会误触发回合结束播报）。 - **左键三段式椭圆思考气泡**： 1. **第 1 次左键点击形象**：弹出椭圆思考气泡，展示当前主模型 **5h / 每周剩余额度**、重置倒计时、**上下文占用**与 **已用 Token**（同时触发 `><` 差分与音效）； 2. **第 2 次左键单击气泡**：切换展示猫娘随机台词（内置台词 + 用户自定义台词，支持实时变量占位符）； 3. **第 3 次左键点击气泡**：收起关闭气泡（切换至其他区域或重新触发亦会自动管理）。 - **每轮对话完成自动播报（10 秒自动关闭）**： - 每次模型思考生成结束后，自动弹出椭圆气泡展示**本轮消耗额度变化（如 `5h -1.8%`）**、最新剩余额度与**本轮新增 Token**，**10 秒后自动收起**（也可点击气泡提前关闭，支持在设置中开关）。 - **右键遥测详情卡片 & 独立「⚙️ 挂件设置」面板**： - **右键点击形象**打开完整详情浮窗（上下文长度 + 服务端分桶构成 + 本对话 Token 与缓存命中率 + 模型 5h / 周剩余额度），底部提供 **`🔍 上下文观察窗口`**、**`🔄 刷新`** 与独立的 **`⚙️ 挂件设置`** 按钮。 - **挂件设置支持全部个性化定制**： - 📏 **挂件大小**（`64px` ~ `180px`，默认 `112px`）与 👁 **透明度**（`35%` ~ `100%`）滑块实时预览； - 💭 **气泡大小** 按钮调节（`－` / `小` / `默认` / `大` / `超大` / `＋`，支持 `65%` ~ `160%` 实时缩放）； - 🎨 **默认皮肤**：内置 **`💜 经典紫瞳`** 与 **`💗💛 粉金异瞳`** 两套统一基底五帧差分皮肤一键切换； - 🖼️ **自定义形象**：分别上传修改 `更改主形象` / `思考差分` / `戳一戳差分` / `彩蛋差分` / `确认差分`，支持一键 `↺ 恢复默认`； - 💬 **自定义气泡对话**（输入框 + `+ 添加对话` 按钮，支持逐条删除与动态数据占位符）； - ⚠️ **审查/确认提醒开关 & 确认提醒音效开关**； - 🔊 **戳一下声音**（内置 **Q 弹叮咚** / **软萌喵呜** / **小黄鸭** 离线合成 WAV + **选本地音频**，支持音量调节、静音与 60s 空闲挂起 + IME 输入法组字避让）； - 📍 **四分贴边停靠**：直接按住拖拽至窗口任意边缘自动贴边吸附（靠左自动水平翻转），或点击按钮快速停靠 `右下角` / `左下角` / `右上角` / `左上角`。 ### 2. 输入框统计栏 · 上下文深度观察窗 · Sidecar 侧栏 - **输入框下方 15px 紧凑统计栏**：位于 `[data-testid="agent-input-box"]` 下方，紧凑显示轮次/步数、实时 `tok/s`、累计 Token、精准缓存命中率与上下文占比（可在「挂件设置」中随时显示/隐藏）。 - **可滚动反重力上下文观察窗口**：点击统计栏或右键详情卡的 `🔍 上下文观察窗口` 弹出完整模态分析面板，支持切换会话查看 `System / Tools / Chat` 构成拆解、模型额度倒计时、活跃工具估算、已加载 `SKILL.md`、最重步骤 Top 5 与高频读写文件。 - **原生 Sidecar 侧栏面板**：同时注册 Antigravity `AUX_PANE` Sidecar（`sidecar://gemini-neko-cockpit/neko-cockpit/ui.html`）与配套对话 Skill。 - **无损补丁机制**：通过独立分隔块 `// ===== GEMINI_NEKO_HUD_BEGIN =====` ~ `END` 注入 `app.asar` 内的 `dist/main.js` 与 `dist/preload.js` 末尾，自动生成 `.bak` 备份并完整保留 [`antigravity-zh-plugin`](https://github.com/yunjuanyunshu114-byte/antigravity-zh-plugin)（`AG_ZH`）汉化补丁。 --- ## 📸 运行效果截图

--- ## 📦 详细安装指南 ### 前置要求 1. 已安装 **Google Antigravity 2.0** 桌面客户端（Windows / macOS / Linux 通用；若安装了中文汉化补丁也可直接叠加，互不冲突）。 2. 已安装 **Node.js 18+**（请在终端或 PowerShell 中执行 `node -v` 确认输出版本号，例如 `v18.x` / `v20.x` / `v22.x`）。 ### 第一步：下载源码 方式 A — 使用 Git 克隆（推荐，后续方便 `git pull` 更新）： ```bash git clone https://github.com/yunjuanyunshu114-byte/antigravity-observer.git cd antigravity-observer ``` 方式 B — 直接下载压缩包： 在 GitHub 本仓库页面右上角点击 **Code → Download ZIP**，解压到本地文件夹（支持含中文的目录路径）。 ### 第二步：执行安装 #### 方式 1：Windows 一键双击安装（最推荐） 进入解压或克隆后的文件夹，直接双击运行： ```text 双击安装观察窗补丁.bat ``` 批处理脚本会自动执行以下全部操作： 1. 关闭当前可能锁定 `app.asar` 的 Antigravity 进程（若正在运行）； 2. 将 `plugin.json`、`sidecars/neko-cockpit/`、`assets/`（图标、2 套默认皮肤共 10 帧立绘、8 个音效）、`skills/` 等资源同步到 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\gemini-neko-cockpit`（若您此前保留过 `hud_prefs.json` 个人配置，会自动无损保留）； 3. 校验并通过 `src/asar_patcher.js` 安全重写 `app.asar` 末尾注入块（不破坏原有汉化与主体代码）； 4. 自动重新启动 Antigravity。 #### 方式 2：命令行安装（Windows / macOS / Linux 通用） ```bash # 1. 标准安装：部署 Sidecar 资源 + 构建并尝试写入 app.asar node setup.cjs ``` > **提示（若运行 `node setup.cjs` 时 Antigravity 处于打开状态）**： > - Windows 下由于 `app.asar` 被运行中的客户端占用，`setup.cjs` 会先完成 Sidecar 插件部署，并把已通过 SHA-256 校验的新版 ASAR 暂存为 `app.asar.neko-staged`； > - **Windows 可直接一行结束进程、写入并重启**： > ```bash > node setup.cjs --kill --relaunch > ``` > - **或者手动完全退出 Antigravity 后应用暂存包**： > ```bash > node setup.cjs --apply-staged > ``` #### 其他安装选项（按需使用） ```bash # Antigravity 未安装在默认路径时，手动指定其 resources 目录： node setup.cjs --install-dir "D:\Programs\Antigravity\resources" # 仅安装 Sidecar 侧栏（不改动客户端 app.asar，适合只想用右侧伴生面板的用户）： node setup.cjs --sidecar-only ``` ### 第三步：安装状态校验 ```bash # 查看插件文件与 app.asar 补丁注入状态 node setup.cjs --check # 执行全部 10 项运行契约自检（检查资源同步、ASAR、Transcript/Annotations、Language Server RPC 等） node setup.cjs --doctor ``` 当 `node setup.cjs --check` 返回 `hudMainPatched: true`、`hudPreloadPatched: true` 且 `node setup.cjs --doctor` 显示 `10 passed, 0 warnings, 0 failed` 时，代表已完全安装就绪。 --- ## 🚀 运行原理与日常使用说明 ### 它是如何运行的？ 安装完成后，**无需额外常驻命令行窗口或手动启动后台脚本**： 1. **桌面挂件与观察窗（自动随客户端启动）**：每次打开 **Google Antigravity 2.0** 时，Electron 主进程加载 `hud/main_bridge.js`，渲染窗口自动挂载 `hud/preload_hud.js` 并在当前会话窗口显示右下角 Gemini 猫娘与输入框统计栏。 2. **Sidecar 观测服务（由客户端按需拉起）**：Antigravity 会根据 `sidecars/neko-cockpit/sidecar.json` 自动管理并运行本地 `server.cjs`，负责读取 Antigravity Language Server 实时额度与会话分桶数据；当窗口桥接层处于轻量上下文模式时亦会自动复用相同本地协议进行降级兜底查询。 3. **配置与自定义素材持久化路径**： - --- ## 📦 详细安装指南 ### 前置要求 1. 已安装 **Google Antigravity 2.0** 桌面客户端（Windows / macOS / Linux 通用；若安装了中文汉化补丁也可直接叠加，互不冲突）。 2. 已安装 **Node.js 18+**（请在终端或 PowerShell 中执行 `node -v` 确认输出版本号，例如 `v18.x` / `v20.x` / `v22.x`）。 ### 第一步：下载源码 方式 A — 使用 Git 克隆（推荐，后续方便 `git pull` 更新）： ```bash git clone https://github.com/yunjuanyunshu114-byte/antigravity-observer.git cd antigravity-observer ``` 方式 B — 直接下载压缩包： 在 GitHub 本仓库页面右上角点击 **Code → Download ZIP**，解压到本地文件夹（支持含中文的目录路径）。 ### 第二步：执行安装 #### 方式 1：Windows 一键双击安装（最推荐） 进入解压或克隆后的文件夹，直接双击运行： ```text 双击安装观察窗补丁.bat ``` 批处理脚本会自动执行以下全部操作： 1. 关闭当前可能锁定 `app.asar` 的 Antigravity 进程（若正在运行）； 2. 将 `plugin.json`、`sidecars/neko-cockpit/`、`assets/`（图标、2 套默认皮肤共 10 帧立绘、8 个音效）、`skills/` 等资源同步到 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\gemini-neko-cockpit`（若您此前保留过 `hud_prefs.json` 个人配置，会自动无损保留）； 3. 校验并通过 `src/asar_patcher.js` 安全重写 `app.asar` 末尾注入块（不破坏原有汉化与主体代码）； 4. 自动重新启动 Antigravity。 #### 方式 2：命令行安装（Windows / macOS / Linux 通用） ```bash # 1. 标准安装：部署 Sidecar 资源 + 构建并尝试写入 app.asar node setup.cjs ``` > **提示（若运行 `node setup.cjs` 时 Antigravity 处于打开状态）**： > - Windows 下由于 `app.asar` 被运行中的客户端占用，`setup.cjs` 会先完成 Sidecar 插件部署，并把已通过 SHA-256 校验的新版 ASAR 暂存为 `app.asar.neko-staged`； > - **Windows 可直接一行结束进程、写入并重启**： > ```bash > node setup.cjs --kill --relaunch > ``` > - **或者手动完全退出 Antigravity 后应用暂存包**： > ```bash > node setup.cjs --apply-staged > ``` #### 其他安装选项（按需使用） ```bash # Antigravity 未安装在默认路径时，手动指定其 resources 目录： node setup.cjs --install-dir "D:\Programs\Antigravity\resources" # 仅安装 Sidecar 侧栏（不改动客户端 app.asar，适合只想用右侧伴生面板的用户）： node setup.cjs --sidecar-only ``` ### 第三步：安装状态校验 ```bash # 查看插件文件与 app.asar 补丁注入状态 node setup.cjs --check # 执行全部 10 项运行契约自检（检查资源同步、ASAR、Transcript/Annotations、Language Server RPC 等） node setup.cjs --doctor ``` 当 `node setup.cjs --check` 返回 `hudMainPatched: true`、`hudPreloadPatched: true` 且 `node setup.cjs --doctor` 显示 `10 passed, 0 warnings, 0 failed` 时，代表已完全安装就绪。 --- ## 🚀 运行原理与日常使用说明 ### 它是如何运行的？ 安装完成后，**无需额外常驻命令行窗口或手动启动后台脚本**： 1. **桌面挂件与观察窗（自动随客户端启动）**：每次打开 **Google Antigravity 2.0** 时，Electron 主进程加载 `hud/main_bridge.js`，渲染窗口自动挂载 `hud/preload_hud.js` 并在当前会话窗口显示右下角 Gemini 猫娘与输入框统计栏。 2. **Sidecar 观测服务（由客户端按需拉起）**：Antigravity 会根据 `sidecars/neko-cockpit/sidecar.json` 自动管理并运行本地 `server.cjs`，负责读取 Antigravity Language Server 实时额度与会话分桶数据；当窗口桥接层处于轻量上下文模式时亦会自动复用相同本地协议进行降级兜底查询。 3. **配置与自定义素材持久化路径**： - 配置文件：`%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\gemini-neko-cockpit\hud_prefs.json`（Windows；macOS/Linux 在 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/gemini-neko-cockpit/hud_prefs.json`） - 自定义上传形象：`同目录/assets/custom/` - 以上个人配置与图片在更新补丁时会被 `setup.cjs` 自动保留。 ### 日常操作速查表 | 操作方式 | 触发效果 | | :--- | :--- | | **静默待机** | 右下角 `0px` 贴边显示 Gemini 娘主形象，带有微呼吸动画，无多余控件遮挡 | | **AI 开始思考 / 输出中** | 自动切换为统一配色的 **「吃大米」差分**，并记录本轮开始前的额度与 Token 基线 | | **审查需求 / 确认或提问** | 立即切换专属 **`wait` 确认差分**、播放 `review_alert.wav` 提示音，并弹出琥珀边框气泡显示 **【项目名】请求主人确认啦！**；点击确认后自动收起并回到 `eat` 或 `idle` 状态 | | **每次模型对话结束** | 自动弹出椭圆气泡播报 **本轮额度消耗、最新剩余与本轮新增 Token**（10 秒自动关闭），同时触发呲牙笑彩蛋 | | **左键点击猫娘（第 1 次）** | 播放音效、切换 `><` 差分与 Q 弹动效，并在椭圆思考气泡内展示 **模型额度 / 上下文 / Token** | | **左键点击气泡（第 2 次）** | 平滑淡入切换显示 **随机台词**（含您在设置中添加的自定义对话） | | **左键点击气泡（第 3 次）** | 关闭思考气泡 | | **鼠标左键按住拖拽** | 在窗口内自由拖动位置，松手后自动四分之一边缘贴边吸附（拖至左侧自动水平镜像翻转） | | **鼠标右键点击猫娘** | 打开 **完整遥测卡片**（上下文长度拆解、Token 累计与命中率、各模型 5h/每周额度），下方可一键进入 **⚙️ 挂件设置** | | **点击输入框下方统计栏** | 打开 **反重力上下文观察窗口**，支持切换历史对话深入排查 Tool / Skill / File 占用 | | **Sidecar 面板 / 对话唤起** | 在 Antigravity 对话中提及「打开反重力观察窗」，或打开 `sidecar://gemini-neko-cockpit/neko-cockpit/ui.html` | ### 自定义气泡台词支持的实时变量 在 **`⚙️ 挂件设置 → 💬 自定义气泡对话`** 输入任意台词并点击 **`+ 添加对话`** 时，可在文本中插入以下动态占位符（运行时会自动替换为当前会话的真实数值）： | 占位符 | 含义 | 示例输出 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `{quota_5h}` | 当前主模型 5 小时窗口剩余百分比 | `94.6` | | `{quota_week}` | 当前主模型每周窗口剩余百分比 | `86.2` | | `{ctx_pct}` | 当前上下文窗口占用百分比 | `36.1` | | `{ctx_used}` | 当前上下文已用 Token | `184.6K` | | `{ctx_max}` | 当前上下文窗口上限 | `512K` | | `{tokens}` | 本对话累计总 Token | `1.86M` | | `{model}` | 当前会话模型名称 | `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (XHigh)` | --- ## 🔄 更新、卸载与常见排查 ### 如何更新插件？ ```bash cd antigravity-observer git pull origin main ``` 随后直接再次双击 [`双击安装观察窗补丁.bat`](./双击安装观察窗补丁.bat)（或执行 `node setup.cjs --kill --relaunch`）即可，原有的自定义形象、气泡台词、大小与音量设置会自动保留。 ### 如何安全卸载？ - **Windows**：直接双击 [`双击卸载观察窗补丁.bat`](./双击卸载观察窗补丁.bat)。 - **命令行**： ```bash node setup.cjs --uninstall --kill --relaunch ``` 卸载程序会自动清理 `GEMINI_NEKO_HUD` 注入代码与 Sidecar 插件目录，**原有官方文件及中文汉化补丁均不会受到任何损坏**。 ### 常见问题排查 (FAQ) 1. **Antigravity 客户端更新版本后，猫娘挂件消失了？** 客户端官方更新会覆盖原有的 `resources/app.asar`，属于正常现象；只需重新双击一次 [`双击安装观察窗补丁.bat`](./双击安装观察窗补丁.bat) 即可一键恢复（`hud_prefs.json` 中的个人配置还在）。 2. **命令行执行 `node setup.cjs` 提示窗口被占用 / 已暂存 `.neko-staged`？** 说明 Antigravity 进程仍在运行并锁住了 `app.asar`。只需彻底退出 Antigravity 后执行 `node setup.cjs --apply-staged`，或在 Windows 下直接执行 `node setup.cjs --kill --relaunch`。 3. **修改气泡大小后感觉太小或太大，如何重置？** 在 **`⚙️ 挂件设置 → 💭 气泡大小`** 直接点击 **`默认`** 按钮（`100% / 222×152`），也可配合左侧 **`－`** / **`＋`** 按 10% 精细微调。 4. **如何检查是否与 `AG_ZH` 汉化补丁冲突？** 运行 `node setup.cjs --check`，若输出 `"zhLocalizationIntact": true` 即表示汉化与本插件均完整并存。 --- ## 📁 目录结构 ```text ├── assets/ │ ├── frames/ # 默认经典紫瞳 5 帧统一基底透明 WebP 立绘 (idle / eat / grin / xd / wait) │ ├── skins/ │ │ └── heterochromia/ # 内置粉金异瞳 5 帧统一基底透明 WebP 立绘 (idle / eat / grin / xd / wait) │ ├── sounds/ # 离线合成音效包 (boing / nya / duck / combo_chime / review_alert) │ └── logo.png # 插件图标 (256x256 RGBA) ├── docs/ │ └── screenshots/ # 运行效果截图 (01 ~ 08) ├── hud/ │ ├── main_bridge.js # Electron 主进程桥接、配置迁移持久化、多项目待确认采集、自定义资源选择与 RPC 兜底 │ └── preload_hud.js # 渲染层注入：右下角 Gemini 猫娘挂件、确认提醒气泡、右键详情卡与观察弹窗 ├── sidecars/neko-cockpit/ │ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar 清单 (AUX_PANE) │ ├── server.cjs # 本地观测 HTTP 服务 & Language Server / Transcript 引擎 │ └── ui.html # Sidecar 侧栏 Web UI ├── skills/gemini-neko-cockpit/ │ └── SKILL.md # 对话内快捷调用 Antigravity Skill ├── src/ │ └── asar_patcher.js # ASAR 无损重写与 SHA-256 块校验器 ├── plugin.json # Antigravity 插件元信息 (v1.3.0) ├── setup.cjs # 安装 / 暂存 / 状态检查 / 自检 / 卸载主程序 ├── 双击安装观察窗补丁.bat # Windows 一键安装脚本 └── 双击卸载观察窗补丁.bat # Windows 一键卸载脚本 ``` --- ## 🙏 开源参考与致谢 本项目在交互手感、挂件机制与数据观测架构上参考并致谢以下优秀开源项目： -
